title.narrative: Facility for Oil Sector Transformation II Procurement of services - Technical advice to Government; CSO engagement

description.narrative: FOSTER 2 is the successor programme to the Facility for Oil Sector Transparency and Reform (FOSTER 1), which ran from 2011 to 2016. The programme is implemented by Oxford Policy Management (OPM) and funded by FCDO. Focusing on the extractive industry sector of the Nigerian economy.
